title.ja: 四間飛車の基本、最初の駒組み

paragraphs.ja: ▲7六歩で角道を開け、▲6六歩で閉じてから▲6八飛と振る。△8五歩には▲7七角で飛車先を受ける。角道を止めることで不用意な角交換を避け、飛車・角・銀の位置を整える。
paragraphs.en: Open the bishop diagonal with P-7f, close it with P-6f, and transfer the rook to 6h. Against an advanced enemy rook pawn, B-7g protects the eighth file. The closed diagonal keeps bishops on the board while the rook, bishop, and left silver organize their defensive duties.

paragraphs.ja: 玉は飛車と反対の右辺へ移し、美濃囲いを目指す。飛車を振っただけでは完成ではない。角頭の守りと玉の安全を確認し、相手の仕掛けに合わせて銀を上げる。急戦相手に囲いだけを優先しない。
paragraphs.en: Move the king toward the opposite wing and aim for Mino. Merely swinging the rook does not complete the opening: the bishop head and king still need protection. Develop the silver according to the opponent’s attacking pieces, and interrupt castling when a concrete rook-pawn breakthrough requires an immediate answer.

question.ja: △8五歩に対する基本の受けは？
question.en: What is the basic response to an enemy P-8e?

answer.ja: ▲7七角で8六を守る。
answer.en: B-7g covers 8f.

title.ja: 四間飛車で使う囲い

paragraphs.ja: 片美濃は玉を2八、銀を3八に置き、金は4九に残す。左金を6九から5八へ上げれば本美濃になる。玉を移す前に銀を3八へ上げる順もあるが、駒の通り道が重ならないように組む。
paragraphs.en: Half Mino places the king on 2h and silver on 3h while the right gold remains on 4i. Moving the left gold from 6i to 5h completes full Mino. Follow the actual gold positions rather than memorizing a castle name: blocked king routes and unnecessary gold shuffles waste precious defensive time.

paragraphs.ja: 高美濃は4筋の歩と金を前進させ、銀冠では2筋の歩を突いて銀を2七へ上げる。上からの攻めに強くなる反面、組み替え中の隙と手数が増す。相手が仕掛けられる局面では発展を急がない。
paragraphs.en: High Mino advances the fourth-file pawn and gold; Silver Crown advances the second-file pawn and raises the silver to 2g. These developments improve resistance to frontal pressure but cost moves and temporarily loosen squares. Choose an upgrade only when the opponent cannot exploit the transition with an immediate attack.

question.ja: 銀冠への発展を急いではいけない理由は？
question.en: Why should you avoid rushing into Silver Crown?

answer.ja: 組み替えに手数がかかり、その途中に守りの隙ができる。
answer.en: It costs moves and exposes temporary defensive gaps.

title.ja: 四間飛車、駒組みのパターン

paragraphs.ja: 四間飛車では美濃の堅さを生かし、大駒を交換して攻め合う展開を目指す。7八銀型は銀が角の後ろに残るため、大駒をすぐ捌く含みがある。6七銀型は角頭を支え、飛車の振り直しにも対応しやすい。
paragraphs.en: Fourth-file Rook seeks major-piece exchanges that let Mino’s solidity matter in a mutual attack. A silver remaining on 7h leaves room for immediate rook-and-bishop activity. A silver on 6g instead supports the bishop head and gives flexible protection when the rook changes files to meet an enemy breakthrough.

paragraphs.ja: 6六銀型は銀を前に出して棒銀風に攻め、5六銀型は腰掛け銀として中央や右側への攻めに参加する。銀を上げるほど元の守備位置から離れる。攻めたい筋と相手の仕掛けを見て形を選ぶ。
paragraphs.en: A silver on 6f supports an advancing attack, while a reclining silver on 5f participates in central or right-wing pressure. Advancing the silver also abandons its former defensive squares. Select the formation from the intended attacking file and the opponent’s threat, rather than treating the most advanced silver as automatically best.

question.ja: 6七銀型の主な利点は？
question.en: What is the main benefit of S-6g?

answer.ja: 角頭を支え、相手の攻めに応じた飛車の振り直しを助ける。
answer.en: It protects the bishop head and supports flexible rook transfers.

title.ja: 四間飛車vs棒銀①　居玉棒銀
title.en: Fourth-file Rook versus uncastled Climbing Silver

paragraphs.ja: 居玉棒銀は囲いに手をかけず、飛車・銀・歩を8筋に集中する。単に受け続けると銀が前進して角頭が破られる。相手の銀が進んだ時点で▲6五歩と角道を開ける反撃を検討する。
paragraphs.en: An uncastled Climbing Silver concentrates rook, silver, and pawn on the eighth file without spending time sheltering its king. Passive waiting allows the silver to reach the bishop head. When that silver commits forward, consider P-6e to open the bishop diagonal and activate the major pieces against the exposed enemy camp.

paragraphs.ja: 角道が通れば、飛車の横移動と角の長い利きで銀の進出を逆用できる。ただし▲6五歩は局面を選ぶ。相手の角道が開いているか、飛車を交換できるか、こちらの玉に王手がかからないかを読む。
paragraphs.en: The opened diagonal and a rook transfer can turn the advanced silver into a target. P-6e is a timed counterattack, not a move to play automatically in every formation. Check whether the opposing bishop is active, whether a rook exchange is available, and whether your own king is exposed to forcing checks.

question.ja: 居玉棒銀に対し受け一辺倒が危険なのは？
question.en: Why is purely passive defense dangerous here?

answer.ja: 銀に角頭を突破されるため、角道を開ける反撃の時機が必要。
answer.en: The silver can break through the bishop head; timely counterplay is needed.

title.ja: 四間飛車vs棒銀②　舟囲い棒銀
title.en: Fourth-file Rook versus Boat Castle Climbing Silver

paragraphs.ja: 舟囲い棒銀では相手も玉を移してから攻めるため、居玉棒銀より反撃が通りにくい。▲6七銀型で美濃を整え、△7五歩からの攻めに備える。歩を取る前に銀の進出と歩成の狙いを読む。
paragraphs.en: Boat Castle gives the Climbing Silver side more king safety than a bare-king rush. Prepare Mino and the S-6g formation before the enemy’s seventh-file pawn break. Capturing that pawn without examining the silver advance can lose to a following pawn promotion, even when an attacking silver appears available for capture.

paragraphs.ja: 戦いが7筋に起きるなら飛車もその筋へ回す。角を右側へ引き、大駒をぶつけて交換する筋を探す。目的は銀だけを取ることではなく、飛車角を働かせて堅さを生かした攻め合いに持ち込むこと。
paragraphs.en: Transfer the rook toward the file where fighting actually occurs and consider withdrawing the bishop toward the right. Seek coordinated major-piece exchanges instead of chasing the silver alone. The strategic goal is an active mutual attack with the safer king; an isolated material gain can be misleading if it permits a promoted pawn near your camp.

question.ja: 攻めが7筋に移ったら飛車はどう活用する？
question.en: How should the rook respond to fighting on the seventh file?

answer.ja: 7筋へ回り、大駒の交換を狙う。
answer.en: Transfer toward that file and seek coordinated major-piece exchanges.

title.ja: 四間飛車vs矢倉戦法

paragraphs.ja: 矢倉は上からの攻めには強いが、対抗形での飛車打ちによる横攻めには弱さがある。四間飛車側は▲6七銀と美濃を整え、引き角からの△8六歩に備える。5筋の歩を急いで突かず、角の進路を保つ。
paragraphs.en: Yagura is designed to absorb frontal pressure, but a rook dropped behind it can attack its side effectively. Fourth-file Rook prepares S-6g and Mino while watching the opponent’s withdrawn bishop and eighth-file break. Avoid an unnecessary fifth-file pawn advance when it would interfere with the bishop’s useful diagonal or defensive maneuver.

paragraphs.ja: △8六角には▲8八飛と回って角と飛車を同時に狙う筋がある。持久戦では角道を開け、▲2六歩で桂を支えて▲2五桂、▲4五歩から4筋を攻める。王の角筋への位置が歩の取り方を制限する。
paragraphs.en: Against a bishop emerging on 8f, R-8h can threaten both bishop and rook. In a slower game, open the diagonal, support an advanced knight with P-2f, and combine N-2e with pressure on the fourth file. Always check whether the opposing king lies on the bishop’s line before evaluating a pawn capture.

question.ja: 矢倉相手に横からの攻めが有効なのは？
question.en: Why can lateral attacks work well against Yagura?

answer.ja: 矢倉の金銀は上からの攻めに向き、横からの飛車の利きに弱さがある。
answer.en: Its defenders are arranged for frontal pressure and can be vulnerable to a rook attacking sideways.

title.ja: 四間飛車vs右四間飛車
title.en: Fourth-file Rook versus Right Fourth-file Rook

paragraphs.ja: 右四間飛車は飛車・角・銀・桂を同じ突破点へ集める。四間飛車側は▲5六銀で6五を支え、相手の桂跳ねを警戒する。△8五桂に▲8六角とかわす形を覚え、角を取られるだけの受けを避ける。
paragraphs.en: Right Fourth-file Rook combines rook, bishop, silver, and knight against one breakthrough square. A defensive S-5f adds protection to 6e. Watch the attacking knight before focusing only on the rook pawn; against N-8e, moving the bishop to 8f can preserve it and create counterattacking possibilities instead of surrendering it passively.

paragraphs.ja: 片美濃・本美濃・高美濃で守備駒の利きが違い、△6五歩の取り方も変わる。高美濃なら銀で取る筋や▲6六歩の焦点の歩を読む。銀を相手に渡した後の打ち込みまで含め、飛車を捌けるか確認する。
paragraphs.en: Half Mino, full Mino, and High Mino defend different squares, so the answer to a pawn break is formation dependent. A silver capture or a focal pawn drop on 6f may become possible in the stronger castle. Include enemy silver drops in your calculation and verify that your rook can still become active after exchanges.

question.ja: △8五桂への角のかわし方は？
question.en: Where can the bishop retreat against N-8e?

answer.ja: ▲8六角を検討する。
answer.en: Consider B-8f.

title.ja: 四間飛車vs居飛車穴熊
title.en: Fourth-file Rook versus Static Rook Anaguma

paragraphs.ja: 穴熊に完成まで待たれると美濃の堅さだけでは勝てない。▲3九玉で待機し、端歩と桂の活用で相手の方針を確かめる。角の長い利きと右桂を攻めに使い、相手の角を動かすことを目標にする。
paragraphs.en: If Static Rook completes Anaguma unchallenged, Mino alone does not guarantee a favorable race. Keeping the king on 3i temporarily can preserve attacking options while edge pawns and knight development reveal the opponent’s plan. Coordinate the bishop’s long diagonal with the right knight and look for ways to displace the enemy bishop.

paragraphs.ja: 相手が穴熊へ入る瞬間に▲4五歩と仕掛け、飛車を4筋へ回す筋を読む。穴熊を断念した場合は中央の守りも必要となる。速攻が間に合うか、角筋が王に通るか、5筋の反撃を受けられるかが判断点。
paragraphs.en: A fourth-file pawn break and rook transfer can exploit the moment the enemy king enters the corner. If the opponent abandons Anaguma, the center may need additional defense instead. Judge the attack by its timing, the bishop line toward the king, and your ability to withstand a counterattack on the fifth file.

question.ja: 穴熊への攻めで重要な時機は？
question.en: What timing matters when attacking Anaguma?

answer.ja: 囲い完成前、玉が角筋に入る瞬間を狙う。
answer.en: Attack before completion, particularly when the king enters the bishop’s diagonal.

title.ja: 立石流四間飛車の指し方

paragraphs.ja: 立石流は四間飛車から▲6五歩で角交換を迫り、▲7五歩を急いで石田流へ組み替える。持久戦相手に使う構想で、相手が急戦なら▲7七角と銀の守備を省かず、普通の四間飛車で対応する。
paragraphs.en: Tateishi begins like closed-diagonal Fourth-file Rook, then opens the diagonal and advances the seventh-file pawn to transform into Ishida. It is intended for slower opponents. Against a fast attack, keep the bishop-head and silver defenses required by ordinary Fourth-file Rook instead of omitting them merely to reach the desired attacking formation.

paragraphs.ja: 角交換後は銀を8八へ置いて角打ちの隙を消し、飛車を浮いて7六へ回す。8筋で飛車交換を迫り相手に歩を打たせる構想がある。相手の△7四歩が先なら7筋の位を取れず、同じ駒組みは成立しない。
paragraphs.en: After exchanging bishops, protect your camp against bishop drops before lifting the rook and moving it toward 7f. Challenging the enemy rook on the eighth file may force a pawn drop and reduce its mobility. If the opponent has already played P-7d, the seventh-file space needed for this formation is no longer freely available.

question.ja: 立石流で▲7五歩を急ぐ理由は？
question.en: Why is P-7e urgent in Tateishi?

answer.ja: 石田流へ組み替える7筋の位が必要で、△7四歩で妨げられるから。
answer.en: The Ishida transition requires seventh-file space that P-7d can prevent.

title.ja: 藤井システムの駒組み

paragraphs.ja: 藤井システムは藤井猛による四間飛車の構想。玉を居玉に保ち、金銀だけ美濃の形にして手数を攻めへ回す。端歩を早く突き、角と桂を働かせ、穴熊や天守閣美濃の完成前を攻める。
paragraphs.en: The Fujii System, developed by Takeshi Fujii, spends its opening tempi on an attack rather than immediately moving the king. The golds and silver resemble Mino while the king remains in its original square. Early edge-pawn advances and bishop-and-knight coordination target Anaguma or Left Mino before their defenders finish organizing.

paragraphs.ja: 居玉のまま攻めるのは条件付きで、相手の作戦を見分ける必要がある。急戦を示されたら玉を移して守る。穴熊相手の端攻め、左美濃相手の玉頭攻め、急戦への捌きを同じ手順に混ぜない。
paragraphs.en: The bare king is a conditional resource, not permission to ignore king safety. Once the opponent shows a quick attack, begin moving the king into shelter. Distinguish edge pressure against Anaguma, king-head pressure against Left Mino, and defensive exchanges against rapid attacks; each plan requires its own timing and piece arrangement.

question.ja: 相手が急戦を示したら居玉を続ける？
question.en: Should the king remain unmoved against a quick attack?

answer.ja: 続けず、玉を移して囲いを整える。
answer.en: No; move the king and complete the necessary defenses.

title.ja: 藤井システムvs居飛車穴熊

paragraphs.ja: 早めの桂跳ねで相手の角道を止め、穴熊を目指したら端歩を伸ばす。▲2五桂は角の利きと連動した仕掛けで、桂単独の攻めではない。端の歩交換から攻め駒と持ち歩を確保する。
paragraphs.en: An early knight development can encourage the opponent to close the bishop diagonal; an Anaguma commitment then invites an edge-pawn advance. N-2e works with the bishop’s line rather than as a lone knight raid. Edge pawn exchanges supply the pawns needed to keep threats going and open access to the cornered king.

paragraphs.ja: もう一つの入り口は▲4五歩で角交換を狙う攻め。桂頭への攻撃と端の歩を取る筋を組み合わせる。相手の穴熊の金銀配置を確認し、松尾流のような補強が入った形へ旧来の攻めを機械的に当てはめない。
paragraphs.en: A fourth-file pawn break provides another route, often involving bishop exchange and pressure on the enemy knight’s head. Combine that central action with edge resources instead of considering the variations independently. Inspect the actual gold-and-silver arrangement: reinforced Anaguma formations, including Matsuo-style structures, may neutralize a threat that worked against a simpler castle.

question.ja: ▲2五桂の攻めに何を連動させる？
question.en: What should support the N-2e attack?

answer.ja: 角の斜めの利きと端攻めを連動させる。
answer.en: Coordinate the bishop diagonal with edge pressure.

title.ja: 藤井システムvs天守閣美濃(左美濃)

paragraphs.ja: 天守閣美濃は玉が高い位置にいるため玉頭を狙う。▲3九玉まで移して安全を確保し、早い桂跳ねと4筋の位取りで攻めの土台を作る。相手が角を引いたら▲6七銀で飛車が8筋へ回る道を空ける。
paragraphs.en: Tower Mino places the king higher than ordinary Left Mino, making its head a natural target. Move your own king toward 3i when the position requires shelter, and establish attacking space with early knight development and fourth-file control. Against a withdrawn enemy bishop, S-6g clears the rook’s route to the eighth file for defense.

paragraphs.ja: ▲2五歩から玉頭へ歩を使い、1筋と3筋を絡める。相手の△8六歩の引き角攻めには飛車を8筋へ回す受けがある。攻めだけに集中せず、敵の飛車先への受けと逆襲を両立させる。
paragraphs.en: A second-file pawn break can start pressure against the king’s head, supported by action on the adjacent first and third files. If the opposing withdrawn bishop attacks with an eighth-file break, a rook transfer to that file may be necessary. Keep defense and counterattack connected rather than assuming the opponent must accept your initiative.

question.ja: 天守閣美濃のどこを狙う？
question.en: Which part of Tower Mino is the main target?

answer.ja: 高い位置にいる玉の頭を歩・桂・角で狙う。
answer.en: Attack the elevated king’s head with coordinated pawns, knight, and bishop.

title.ja: 藤井システムvs居飛車急戦

paragraphs.ja: 8筋と7筋の歩が伸び、銀が前進するなら相手は急戦を狙っている。藤井システムの居玉を続けず、玉を右へ移す。△7五歩の突き捨てと△6四銀に備え、攻められる歩の前進で相手の手をずらす筋を読む。
paragraphs.en: Advancing eighth- and seventh-file pawns together with a silver signals a quick attack. Stop treating the unmoved king as the default and begin castling to the right. Watch the seventh-file pawn sacrifice followed by a silver advance; sometimes moving the threatened pawn forward changes the attacker’s targets more effectively than passively protecting it.

paragraphs.ja: 角道を開けて大駒をぶつけ、隙を見て美濃を完成させる。飛車角の総交換になれば囲いの差が重要となる。ただし居玉のまま交換すると王手の打ち込みがあるため、交換後の持ち駒まで具体的に読む。
paragraphs.en: Open the bishop diagonal when it permits active major-piece exchanges and complete Mino whenever the opponent’s threats allow it. A full rook-and-bishop exchange magnifies the difference in king safety. Calculate the resulting pieces in hand and forcing drops: exchanging everything while your king remains exposed may simply give the enemy a decisive attack.

question.ja: 急戦相手に大駒交換前に確認することは？
question.en: What must be checked before major-piece exchanges against a quick attack?

answer.ja: 自玉の安全と交換後の王手の打ち込み。
answer.en: Your king’s safety and forcing enemy drops after the exchange.

title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車の基本、最初の駒組み

paragraphs.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車は主に後手番で使い、早い△5四歩から△5二飛と中央へ振る。角道を開けたまま駒組みし、△5五歩で相手の角筋を止める。5筋の位は銀の進出と中央突破の足場となる。
paragraphs.en: Gokigen Central Rook is usually studied from White’s side: advance the fifth-file pawn early and transfer the rook to 5b. Keep the bishop diagonal open until P-5e blocks the opposing bishop’s line. That central space supports silver development and future fifth-file pressure, giving the opening a more active character than closed-diagonal Ranging Rook.

paragraphs.ja: 角交換や飛車先突破を早く許す変化もあるため、中央の歩だけを優先しない。飛車と角の利きで8筋ではなく相手の2筋の攻めを受ける必要がある。向きを反転して覚えるときも、後手の手番と座標を混同しない。
paragraphs.en: Early bishop exchange and an opponent’s rook-pawn breakthrough both require concrete calculation, not more central pawn pushes by habit. From White’s perspective the enemy attack comes down the second file. When reviewing a flipped board, keep the absolute coordinates and whose turn it is clear so that defensive moves are not accidentally mirrored into the wrong formation.

question.ja: △5五歩にはどのような役割がある？
question.en: What role does White’s P-5e play?

answer.ja: 中央の位を取り、相手の角道を止める。
answer.en: It claims central space and blocks the opposing bishop diagonal.

notes.en: Develop the bishop to 3c to meet the advanced second-file pawn.

title.ja: 先手番中飛車の駒組み

paragraphs.ja: 先手番中飛車は初手▲5六歩で中央の方針を示す。△8四歩なら▲7六歩で角道を開け、▲5五歩を目指す。△3四歩なら先に▲5八飛と振り、角道を開ける前に5五の歩で角筋を止める順を選べる。
paragraphs.en: Black Central Rook begins with P-5f. Against P-8d, opening the bishop diagonal can accompany the plan to claim 5e. Against P-3d, moving the rook to 5h first preserves the option of establishing the central pawn before opening your diagonal, reducing the chance of an unwanted early bishop exchange or forcing attack.

paragraphs.ja: 同じ基本形でも相手の2手目で順序を変える。飛車先を伸ばされたら角頭への受けが必要で、角道を早く開けすぎると交換後の角打ちが問題になる。5五の位を守れる銀の配置と玉の逃げ道を準備する。
paragraphs.en: The destination may look similar, but the opponent’s second move changes the safest route. An advancing rook pawn requires bishop-head defense, while an opened diagonal introduces bishop exchanges and drops. Prepare silver support for the central pawn and a safe king route rather than advancing every pawn before coordinating the rest of the army.

question.ja: △3四歩に対する中飛車の手順上の工夫は？
question.en: What move-order option is useful against P-3d?

answer.ja: ▲5八飛を先に指し、▲5五歩で角筋を止めてから角道を開ける。
answer.en: Play R-5h first and consider establishing P-5e before opening the bishop diagonal.

title.en: Establish the center before opening the diagonal

notes.ja: 学習用の基本手順。先に5筋の歩を突き、中飛車を示す。
notes.en: Teaching sequence; adapt to different replies. Advance the central pawn first, signaling Central Rook.
Open White’s bishop diagonal.
Transfer the rook to the central file.
Advance White’s rook pawn.

notes.ja: 5筋の位を取り、中央に圧力をかける。
notes.en: Claim fifth-file space to exert central pressure.
Prepare a breakthrough on 8f.
Open the bishop diagonal.
Develop White’s left silver toward the center.

notes.ja: 角頭を守る駒を7七へ置く。
notes.en: Place a defender on 7g to cover the bishop-head area.

title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車で使う囲い

paragraphs.ja: 中飛車では攻め銀を中央へ使うため、まず片美濃の少ない手数で玉を守る。高美濃や木村美濃へ発展する選択もあり、角のコビンへの攻撃を受けるか、上からの攻めを受けるかで守備形を選ぶ。
paragraphs.en: Central Rook normally uses a silver for central attacking duties, making Half Mino an economical starting shelter. High Mino and Kimura Mino offer alternative defensive development. Choose by the enemy’s approach: pressure along a bishop diagonal and direct attacks from above demand different square coverage, so castle names alone do not determine the correct arrangement.

paragraphs.ja: 急戦には金美濃の受けを考え、持久戦なら振り飛車穴熊も選べる。相振りでは右の囲いが攻撃目標になるため左穴熊の構想がある。囲いを深くする手数と中央の守りを両方確認し、無条件に穴熊を目指さない。
paragraphs.en: Gold Mino can be considered against rapid attacks, while a slower game may permit Ranging Rook Anaguma. In Double Ranging Rook, Left Anaguma changes the side on which the king faces enemy pressure. Account for castling tempi and central defense together; a deeper castle is useful only if you can survive the moves needed to build it.

question.ja: 中飛車で片美濃が使いやすい理由は？
question.en: Why is Half Mino convenient for Central Rook?

answer.ja: 中央に銀を使いながら少ない手数で玉を守れる。
answer.en: It shelters the king efficiently while a silver works in the center.

title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車の基本の攻め筋

paragraphs.ja: 中央の位を取ったら銀を前へ繰り出し、飛車・銀・歩で5筋を攻める。片美濃に玉を入れてから中央突破を目指す。5筋の歩を交換できるか、銀が前へ出た後に角頭が弱くならないかを見る。
paragraphs.en: After claiming central space, bring a silver forward so rook, silver, and pawn can cooperate on the fifth file. Half Mino gives the king shelter before committing to a breakthrough. Evaluate whether the central pawn can be exchanged and whether the silver’s departure leaves your bishop head vulnerable; attacking development must still preserve the camp’s essential defenses.

paragraphs.ja: 角交換は中央へ持ち角を投入する手段にもなる。敵陣への角打ちで5筋の利きを増やし、相手の守りを上回る駒数を集める。角を交換しただけで攻めが成立するわけではなく、相手の角打ちと飛車の退路も読む。
paragraphs.en: Bishop exchange can supply a bishop in hand that reinforces the central attack from a suitable drop square. Count attackers and defenders on the intended breakthrough rather than assuming the exchange itself creates an advantage. Also calculate the opponent’s bishop drops and your rook’s retreat: an active central rook can become trapped if the supporting pieces move too far ahead.

question.ja: 中央突破で数えるべきものは？
question.en: What should be counted before a central breakthrough?

answer.ja: 突破点に利く攻め駒と守り駒、交換後の持ち角の働き。
answer.en: Attackers and defenders on the target square, including the bishops in hand after exchanges.

title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車vs超急戦

paragraphs.ja: 超急戦は中央の角筋が閉じる時機に仕掛け、角交換から乱戦へ入る。飛車先と角の利きを同時に使うため一手の遅れが大きい。▲5五桂の打ち込みなど、交換で得た桂を使う攻めも読む必要がある。
paragraphs.en: The super-rapid variation attacks at the moment the central pawn closes a bishop line, then forces major-piece exchanges and a tactical fight. Rook-pawn pressure and bishop activity work together, so a single slow move can matter enormously. Calculate the pieces gained through exchanges, including attacking knight drops on 5e, instead of studying only the first pawn break.

paragraphs.ja: 乱戦を避けたいなら角道を開けたままにする順や△3二金で受けを整える順を検討する。回避は中飛車を捨てる意味ではない。相手の仕掛けが成立する条件を一つ変え、別の駒組みへ誘導する。
paragraphs.en: If you prefer a less forcing game, consider keeping the diagonal open longer or answering the enemy rook-pawn exchange with G-3b. The latter permits a defensive pawn drop after the rook retreats. Avoiding the tactical race does not abandon Central Rook; it changes the conditions that enable immediate forcing attacks and leads toward a quieter middlegame.

question.ja: 超急戦を回避する工夫の一つは？
question.en: Name one way to avoid the super-rapid variation.

answer.ja: △3二金で守りを整える、または角道を開けた順を選ぶ。
answer.en: Add G-3b or choose a sequence that keeps the bishop diagonal open.

title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車vs超速3七銀

paragraphs.ja: 超速▲3七銀は右銀を素早く前進させ、中央の位と角頭へ圧力をかける。中飛車側も銀を早く上げて銀対抗に構え、美濃を目指す。囲いだけを急ぐと、中央の銀の数が足りなくなる。
paragraphs.en: Rapid S-3g develops Black’s right silver quickly to challenge central space and the bishop head. Central Rook answers by developing a silver promptly into a silver-opposition structure while preparing Mino. Spending every move on castling can leave the central struggle underdefended, so the attacking silver’s destination matters more than its opening label.

paragraphs.ja: 銀交換後は△4四角から大駒を捌く筋や自陣飛車で美濃を補強する筋がある。相手が角道を閉じて持久戦へ変えたら、飛車を弱い筋へ振り直す。超速二枚銀ではさらに中央の守備駒を数える。
paragraphs.en: After silver exchanges, bishop activity from 4d and defensive rook drops can help coordinate the counterattack and reinforce Mino. If the opponent closes the bishop diagonal and switches to a slower plan, transfer the rook toward a weaker file. Against a two-silver version, reassess the central attacker count instead of repeating the one-silver response automatically.

question.ja: 超速に対し中飛車側が銀を急いで上げる理由は？
question.en: Why must Central Rook develop its silver promptly against rapid S-3g?

answer.ja: 中央の位と角頭への銀の圧力を銀対抗で受けるため。
answer.en: To meet silver pressure against the center and bishop head.

title.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車vs一直線穴熊

paragraphs.ja: 相手が銀を急がず一直線に穴熊へ向かうときは、中飛車側から攻める計画が必要。袖飛車へ振り直し、角の利きと合わせて弱い筋を狙う。5筋に飛車を置き続けること自体は目的ではない。
paragraphs.en: An opponent heading straight into Anaguma without committing a silver attack gives Central Rook time to choose its own pressure. A Sleeve Rook transfer can coordinate the rook with the bishop against a weaker file. Keeping the rook on the fifth file is not an obligation when the center is closed and the enemy castle is becoming stronger.

paragraphs.ja: 相穴熊で堅さを合わせる構想もある。7筋の歩交換で持ち歩を確保し、囲いを固めてから角筋を使って攻める。早い穴熊と金銀を整えた穴熊では同じ攻めが通るとは限らず、完成度と手数を比較する。
paragraphs.en: Another plan is to match solidity with your own Anaguma. Exchanging a seventh-file pawn supplies material for pawn-drop attacks before using the bishop diagonal. Compare castling completion and tempi: a king that has merely entered the corner is not equivalent to one protected by a coordinated gold-and-silver shell, and the available attacking window changes accordingly.

question.ja: 中央が閉じているとき飛車はどう使える？
question.en: How can the rook be used when the center is closed?

answer.ja: 袖飛車などへ振り直し、相手の弱い筋を狙う。
answer.en: Transfer to Sleeve Rook or another file targeting an enemy weakness.

title.ja: 角交換四間飛車の駒組み

paragraphs.ja: 角道を閉じずに▲6八飛と振り、相手が△4二玉と動いた時機に角交換する。△同銀なら銀が玉から離れる壁銀になる。交換後は▲8八銀から▲7七銀と進め、角に代わって飛車先を受ける。
paragraphs.en: Leave the bishop diagonal open when transferring the rook to 6h. Exchanging after the opponent plays K-4b can force a silver recapture that separates the silver from its king. Your own silver then develops through 8h to 7g, taking over the rook-pawn defense formerly provided by the bishop in ordinary Fourth-file Rook.

paragraphs.ja: 囲いは片美濃が基本だが、角が持ち駒なので先に▲3八銀とすると△2八角の隙がある。飛車先を先に交換された場合は角交換から▲7七角で飛車銀両取りを狙う。角打ちを含めた受けを準備する。
paragraphs.en: Half Mino is a practical shelter, but bishops in hand change the safe move order: S-3h before moving the king may allow a troublesome bishop drop on 2h. If the enemy exchanges the rook pawn before your silver is ready, bishop exchange followed by B*7g can provide a rook-and-silver fork instead of passive defense.

question.ja: 角交換後、飛車先を守る駒は？
question.en: Which piece usually protects the rook-pawn file after bishop exchange?

answer.ja: ▲7七銀の銀で守る。
answer.en: The silver developed to 7g.

title.ja: 角交換四間飛車 逆棒銀の攻め方

paragraphs.ja: 角交換四間飛車から片美濃を組み、飛車を8八へ振り直す。▲8六歩、△同歩、▲同銀で銀を進め、相手の飛車先だった8筋を逆襲する。銀を8五へ出し、高い歩で飛車の活動を制限する構想。
paragraphs.en: After Bishop-exchange Fourth-file Rook and Half Mino, transfer the rook to 8h. P-8f, Px8f, and Sx8f start Reverse Climbing Silver: the opponent’s original rook file becomes your attacking file. A silver advance toward 8e and a well-supported pawn drop higher on that file can restrict the opposing rook’s available squares.

paragraphs.ja: △7四歩が先なら△7三桂で単純な逆棒銀を受けられる。銀を6六へ使い、7筋の歩を交換して▲7二歩の叩きで飛車をずらす。相手が△8五歩を保留する飛車先不突き型なら、同じ8筋の仕掛けはない。
paragraphs.en: If the opponent has already played P-7d, N-7c can stop the straightforward advance. Shift attention to the seventh file, obtain a pawn, and consider P*7b to deflect the rook before returning to the eighth-file attack. Against a formation that has not advanced P-8e, the original pawn contact needed for the basic attack is absent.

question.ja: △7四歩で逆棒銀を防がれたら？
question.en: What plan changes when P-7d prevents the basic attack?

answer.ja: 7筋で歩を得て、▲7二歩などで飛車をずらす。
answer.en: Obtain a pawn on the seventh file and use a drop such as P*7b to deflect the rook.

title.ja: ダイレクト向かい飛車

paragraphs.ja: 後手から早く角交換し、銀を2二から3三へ上げて△2二飛と直接向かい飛車に振る。一度△4二飛とする角交換四間飛車より手数を省くが、4三への飛車の守りがなく、▲6五角の両狙いを許す。
paragraphs.en: White exchanges bishops early, develops the silver through 2b to 3c, and moves the rook directly to 2b. Skipping an intermediate Fourth-file Rook move saves time but removes the rook’s protection of 4c. A bishop drop on 6e can therefore threaten both 4c and 8c, making the saved tempo a tactical tradeoff.

paragraphs.ja: ▲6五角には△7四角の合わせが基本の切り返し。角を再交換して再び打たれた場合は、△2四歩から飛車先の逆襲を読む。片美濃まで無事に組めば逆棒銀へ合流できるが、序盤の筋違い角の対策を先に覚える。
paragraphs.en: B*7d is a thematic answer to B*6e. If another bishop exchange is followed by a renewed drop, second-file pawn pressure can provide counterplay. Reaching Half Mino safely allows a transition to Reverse Climbing Silver, but the direct route requires understanding these off-diagonal bishop tactics before relying on the quieter formation you hope to achieve.

question.ja: 直接向かい飛車にすると生じる角打ちの急所は？
question.en: Which bishop drop is a key tactical issue in Direct Opposing Rook?

answer.ja: 先手の▲6五角。△7四角の切り返しを読む。
answer.en: Black’s B*6e; calculate the answering B*7d.

title.ja: 相振り飛車の基本　先手向かい飛車vs後手三間飛車

paragraphs.ja: 相振りは囲いを縦から攻める将棋で、対抗形とは守り方が違う。△3五歩から三間飛車を示されたら、先に▲7八銀、▲6七銀で6六を守る。急いで角を上げ向かい飛車にすると、浮き飛車に6六の歩を取られる。
paragraphs.en: Double Ranging Rook often attacks castles from the front rather than from the side, changing the required defenses. Against an early third-file pawn advance, develop the left silver to 6g before rushing into Opposing Rook. Otherwise an enemy floating rook can slide across the sixth rank and capture the pawn that closes your bishop diagonal.

paragraphs.ja: 金無双は先に▲2八銀と上げ、△5五角の攻めを防いでから玉と金を動かす。飛車先交換の時機に浮き飛車へ構え、▲6六角と▲7七桂で攻めの形を整える。9筋の端歩は将来の端攻めに備える。
paragraphs.en: When building Gold Fortress, developing S-2h first can prevent a troublesome bishop attack on 5e before king movement. Look for a safe pawn exchange and floating-rook formation, then coordinate B-6f with N-7g. Advance the ninth-file edge pawn when appropriate so that future edge attacks have room and do not begin from a cramped position.

question.ja: 向かい飛車へ振る前に6七銀を急ぐ理由は？
question.en: Why develop S-6g before transferring to Opposing Rook?

answer.ja: 6六の歩を守り、浮き飛車の横取りを防ぐため。
answer.en: It protects the pawn on 6f from a floating rook’s lateral capture.

title.ja: 中飛車対策　石田流vs中飛車

paragraphs.ja: 中飛車の△5四歩を見たら飛車を振る前に銀を上げる。▲6七銀で5筋を守ってから三間飛車に振り、▲7五歩で浮き飛車を準備する。中央の棒銀に対して▲7六飛の横利きで受ける構想。
paragraphs.en: When an early P-5d suggests Central Rook, develop the silver before choosing your rook file. S-6g covers the fifth file, after which Third-file Rook and P-7e prepare a floating rook. Its lateral influence from 7f can reinforce the center against an advancing silver rather than trying to meet every central threat with a pawn alone.

paragraphs.ja: ▲7七桂を入れ、▲6五歩で飛車の横利きを通してから金無双を組む。攻めは▲6四歩の突き捨てと角の王手を組み合わせる。中飛車側が先手なら受けの手数が足りない場合があるため、同じ浮き飛車の手順を反転して使わない。
paragraphs.en: Develop N-7g and open the rook’s lateral route with P-6e before completing Gold Fortress. An eventual sixth-file pawn sacrifice can prepare a checking bishop entry against Mino. If Central Rook moves first, this defensive sequence may be a tempo too slow; use additional central defenders instead of blindly mirroring the same floating-rook plan.

question.ja: 浮き飛車で中央を守るために何を開ける？

answer.ja: ▲6五歩で6六の障害を除き、六段目の横利きを通す。
answer.en: P-6e clears 6f and opens the rook’s lateral line along the sixth rank.

title.ja: 石田流対策　角交換四間飛車vs石田流

paragraphs.ja: 先手の▲7五歩に後手は△4二飛と振り、角交換を迫る。4三を飛車で守り、▲6五角から馬を作る筋を防ぐ。角交換後は△2二銀や△8二銀で自陣の隙を消してから攻める。
paragraphs.en: Against Black’s early P-7e, White can choose R-4b and challenge with bishop exchange. The rook protects 4c, limiting an off-diagonal B*6e attack. After exchanging bishops, silver development such as S-2b and S-8b secures important drop targets before starting counterplay; an attractive bishop drop is unsafe if it allows an immediate fork in return.

paragraphs.ja: 守備を整えたら△3三銀から△2二飛と向かい飛車へ振り直す。石田側の飛車が浮いた瞬間の△8八角や筋違い角を狙う。ただし△4五角を早く打つと▲5五角の両取りがあり、先に銀の位置を整える必要がある。
paragraphs.en: Once the camp is coordinated, develop S-3c and transfer to Opposing Rook. Watch for enemy rook movement that permits B*8h or another bishop intrusion. An immediate B*4e can lose to a responding B*5e fork, so complete the relevant silver defenses first and calculate both sides’ bishops in hand instead of only your own threat.

question.ja: 最初に△4二飛とする守備上の意味は？
question.en: What defensive purpose does the initial R-4b serve?

answer.ja: 4三を守り、▲6五角の筋違い角を防ぐ。
answer.en: It protects 4c against B*6e.

title.ja: 中飛車左穴熊の指し方

paragraphs.ja: 相振りで中飛車の玉を右に囲うと相手の飛車先から攻められやすい。左穴熊は玉を飛車の攻めと反対の左へ移す構想。▲5六飛と浮いて横利きで相手の速攻を防ぎ、その間に玉を左隅へ囲う。
paragraphs.en: In Double Ranging Rook, a conventional right-wing castle can stand directly in the opponent’s attacking path. Left Anaguma moves the king to the other wing while retaining Central Rook. A floating rook on 5f uses its lateral reach to discourage quick pawn breaks, buying the time needed to move the king safely into the left corner.

paragraphs.ja: ▲2六飛と一時的に回って相手に△2四歩を指させれば、敵の浮き飛車の動きを制限できる。銀を5七から6六へ進めて穴熊を補強し、角引きでさらに締める。先に無理な中央突破をせず、囲いと大駒の働きを整える。
paragraphs.en: A temporary R-2f transfer may induce P-2d and reduce the opposing floating rook’s mobility before your rook returns to the center. Develop the silver through 5g toward 6f to reinforce Anaguma, then improve bishop placement. Avoid forcing a central breakthrough before the castle and major pieces are coordinated; this plan first seeks a defensible position for later exchanges.

question.ja: 相振り中飛車で左へ囲う理由は？
question.en: Why castle left in Double Ranging Central Rook?

answer.ja: 相手の飛車先から玉を遠ざけるため。
answer.en: To move the king away from the opponent’s rook-file attack.

title.ja: 鬼殺し対策

paragraphs.ja: 鬼殺しは▲7七桂から▲6五桂と跳ね、角交換と▲5五角の両取りで桂を助ける奇襲。自然な△6二銀だけでは▲5三桂成の攻めが残る。桂を歩で追う前に、角交換後の銀の守りまで読む。
paragraphs.en: Demon Slayer advances the knight through 7g to 6e, then uses bishop exchange and B*5e to rescue it with a fork. A natural-looking S-6b defense can leave N-5c+ available. Before trying to win the knight with a pawn, calculate the bishop exchange and determine whether the recapturing silver remains protected or becomes a tactical target.

paragraphs.ja: △6二金が対策の要点。▲5五角には△6三金で6四の歩を守り、横利きで5三も押さえる。振り飛車で戦うなら△4二飛から守備を整える。高跳びした桂は弱点でも、具体的な反撃を消してから取りに行く。
paragraphs.en: G-6b is the thematic defensive improvement: after B*5e, G-6c protects the pawn on 6d while covering 5c with its sideways movement. R-4b offers a Ranging Rook approach that also improves protection after bishop exchange. The advanced knight is vulnerable, but collect it only after neutralizing the opponent’s specific checking and forking resources.

question.ja: △6二銀ではなく△6二金とする理由は？
question.en: Why prefer G-6b to S-6b?

answer.ja: △6三金が6四と5三を同時に守り、角の両取りに対応できる。
answer.en: G-6c can cover both 6d and 5c while meeting the bishop fork.

title.ja: 筋違い角対策

paragraphs.ja: 筋違い角は早い角交換から▲4五角と打ち、6三の馬作りと3四の歩取りを狙う。△6二銀で6三を守り、歩を取られたら△3二金で次の角成を防ぐ。1歩の損より馬を作られないことを優先する。
paragraphs.en: Wrong-diagonal Bishop exchanges early and drops on 4e, threatening promotion on 6c while eyeing the pawn on 3d. S-6b covers the first promotion square; after the pawn capture, G-3b prevents a further bishop entry. Losing a pawn is preferable to allowing a dominant horse while your army is still undeveloped and your king remains vulnerable.

paragraphs.ja: 腰掛け銀で中央を支え△4四歩から△4五歩の位を取り、敵角を狭くする。四間飛車への転換や相筋違い角も選択肢だが、前者は手損、後者は乱戦になる。位は銀や桂で支え、歩だけを突きすぎない。
paragraphs.en: A reclining silver can support central space while P-4d followed by P-4e restricts the enemy bishop. Switching to Fourth-file Rook or answering with your own wrong-diagonal bishop are alternatives, but they respectively cost time or invite a tactical fight. Support the space with a silver or knight rather than advancing pawns that can be isolated and attacked.

question.ja: 筋違い角を狭くする代表的な構想は？

answer.ja: 銀で支えて4筋の位を取る。
answer.en: Claim fourth-file space with supporting silver development.

title.ja: パックマン戦法の指し方

paragraphs.ja: ▲7六歩に△4四歩と突き、角で歩を取らせるのがパックマン。▲4四角には△4二飛で角を追い、馬を作られても△3四歩で自分の角を活用する。歩の犠牲で飛車と角の両方を働かせる狙い。
paragraphs.en: Pac-Man answers P-7f with P-4d, offering a pawn to the bishop. If Black takes it, R-4b attacks that bishop and prepares rook activity. Even after the bishop promotes, opening White’s own diagonal with P-3d activates the second major piece. The pawn offer is meant to produce coordinated tactical activity rather than recover the pawn immediately.

paragraphs.ja: 馬と飛車を交換された後の△9五角の王手が重要。合駒で飛車の横利きが止まると銀が取れる。先手は飛車の合駒も読む必要があるが、挑発に応じず▲2六歩などで通常の駒組みを続ければ奇襲の主要変化を避けられる。
paragraphs.en: After a horse-for-rook exchange, a checking B*9e can exploit a blocked rook line and expose a silver. Black may need a rook interposition instead of a natural king move or minor-piece block. The simpler practical defense is to decline the offered pawn and continue normal development, removing the trigger for the opening’s main tactical variations.

question.ja: パックマンの誘いを避ける方法は？

answer.ja: 4四の歩を取らず、▲2六歩など通常の駒組みを進める。
answer.en: Decline the pawn and continue ordinary development such as P-2f.

title.ja: アヒル戦法対策

paragraphs.ja: 浮き飛車で角頭を狙うアヒル戦法には、向かい飛車で飛車先の反撃を準備する。金無双は端攻めと中央の強襲に備える囲い。敵の待ち手に合わせて無目的に待たず、角を4四へ出して飛車へ働きかける。
paragraphs.en: Against Duck’s floating-rook pressure on the bishop head, Opposing Rook prepares a counterattack on the rook file. Gold Fortress offers useful resistance to edge pressure and central raids. Do not simply mirror the opponent’s waiting moves; develop a concrete plan such as bringing the bishop to 4d to attack the floating rook and influence its retreat.

paragraphs.ja: 敵飛車が縦へ引けば銀を空いた場所へ上げ、逆棒銀を狙う。横へ逃げたら歩と銀桂を前進させ、飛車の可動範囲を狭める。もう一枚の銀を端へ使う構想もある。低い囲いへ無理に飛車を切らず、駒の圧迫から突破口を作る。
paragraphs.en: If the rook retreats vertically, advance a silver into the newly opened space for Reverse Climbing Silver. If it moves sideways, use pawns, silver, and knight to reduce its mobility. The second silver can approach along the edge. Build a breakthrough through piece pressure instead of sacrificing a rook against a low castle before the supporting attackers are ready.

question.ja: △4四角で飛車を動かした後に見ることは？
question.en: What should you examine after B-4d forces the rook to move?

answer.ja: 縦に引くか横に逃げるかで、逆棒銀か駒の圧迫を選ぶ。
answer.en: Its retreat direction determines whether to use Reverse Climbing Silver or positional pressure.

title.ja: 嬉野流対策、三間飛車での駒組み

paragraphs.ja: 嬉野流は角道を開けず引き角と斜め棒銀で攻める。三間飛車で待ち、▲6七銀と美濃を整える。▲5六歩は後に▲6八角から▲4六角と使うための準備。相手の引き角だけでなく銀の追加も確認する。
paragraphs.en: Ureshino keeps its original bishop diagonal closed and attacks with a withdrawn bishop plus an oblique silver. Third-file Rook prepares S-6g and Mino while waiting for that attack. P-5f creates room for B-6h followed by B-4f. Inspect additional enemy silver development as well as the bishop, because a second silver can change the available defensive tempo.

paragraphs.ja: △7五歩にはすぐ▲同歩と取らず、角を引いて4六の好位置を目指す。角の長い利きが敵飛車を狙い、銀の動きを制限する。相手に棒銀の応援が入っても、美濃の堅さと大駒の捌きを生かした反撃を目標にする。
paragraphs.en: Against a seventh-file pawn break, consider withdrawing the bishop rather than capturing automatically. Its diagonal from 4f targets the enemy rook and limits silver movement. Even when the opponent adds Climbing Silver support, aim for active exchanges and counterplay that exploit Mino’s solidity, calculating the rook’s diagonal exposure instead of trying to hold every pawn in place.

question.ja: ▲5六歩はどの角の使い方を準備する？
question.en: Which bishop maneuver does P-5f prepare?

answer.ja: ▲6八角から▲4六角。
answer.en: B-6h followed by B-4f.

title.ja: 右四間飛車左美濃の定跡
title.en: Right Fourth-file Rook with Left Mino

paragraphs.ja: 飛車を4八、銀を5六、桂を3七へ配置して4五に利きを集中する。角道を開けたまま左美濃へ囲い、2筋の歩は2六で止め▲2五桂の場所を残す。角を攻めへ参加させるのが単純な飛車攻めとの違い。
paragraphs.en: Place the rook on 4h, silver on 5f, and knight on 3g so all three influence 4e. Keep the bishop diagonal open while building Left Mino, and stop the second-file pawn on 2f to leave 2e available for the knight. The coordinated bishop distinguishes this formation from an unsupported attack down the fourth file alone.

paragraphs.ja: ▲2五桂で3三の駒を動かし、▲4五歩から角筋を使う。矢倉への攻めと四間飛車への攻めでは角の位置が違う。振り飛車相手は先に▲1六歩で△1五角を防ぐ。桂跳ねだけで勝てると考えず、角の逃げ先と飛車を切った後を読む。
paragraphs.en: N-2e displaces a defender on 3c before the fourth-file break activates the bishop. Yagura and Fourth-file Rook place that defender differently, so their variations must be distinguished. Against Ranging Rook, P-1f can prevent B-1e. Calculate the bishop’s retreat and the position after a potential rook sacrifice; a knight jump alone does not guarantee a breakthrough.

question.ja: 2筋の歩を2六で止める理由は？
question.en: Why stop the second-file pawn on 2f?

answer.ja: ▲2五桂と跳ねる場所を空けておくため。
answer.en: To leave 2e available for the attacking knight.

title.ja: 嬉野流定跡まとめ

paragraphs.ja: 嬉野流は▲6八銀で始め、角を7九へ引いて5筋から利きを通す。引き角と斜め棒銀の連携を先に覚え、その後に対棒銀の受けと対四間飛車の鳥刺しを学ぶ。相手の戦法で玉の守り方も変える。
paragraphs.en: Ureshino begins with S-6h and develops a withdrawn bishop through 7i, using the fifth file to open its new diagonal. Learn the bishop-and-oblique-silver coordination first, then study defensive play against Climbing Silver and Bird Stab against Fourth-file Rook. The opponent’s formation changes both the attack and the amount of king shelter you should prepare.

paragraphs.ja: 新嬉野流は角引きを保留して▲5七銀を急ぐため、通常の居飛車へ転換しやすい。旧型と新型の歩の受け方を混ぜると守備の手数が変わる。奇襲という名前に頼らず、8筋の薄さと5六の歩の守りを確認する。
paragraphs.en: New Ureshino delays the bishop withdrawal and prioritizes S-5g, retaining options to enter more conventional Static Rook formations. Mixing its pawn defense with the older setup changes defensive timing. Treat the opening as a set of coordinated plans rather than a surprise that wins automatically: watch the thin eighth-file defense and whether the pawn on 5f has support.

question.ja: 嬉野流で基本形の次に学ぶべき対策は？
question.en: Which responses should follow the basic Ureshino formation?

answer.ja: 棒銀への受けと、四間飛車への鳥刺しの攻め。
answer.en: Defense against Climbing Silver and Bird Stab attacks against Fourth-file Rook.

title.ja: 嬉野流の基本、初手からの駒組み

paragraphs.ja: ▲6八銀から▲7九角と引き、角道を開けずに▲5六歩で新しい斜めの利きを通す。▲7八金で飛車先を支え、歩交換には▲8八歩の低い受けがある。飛車は居飛車のまま使い、銀を5七から4六へ繰り出す。
paragraphs.en: Develop S-6h and withdraw the bishop to 7i without opening the original diagonal. P-5f opens the new diagonal, while G-7h supports the rook-pawn defense. After an enemy pawn exchange, a low P*8h is characteristic of the older setup. Keep the rook in its original file and develop the attacking silver through 5g to 4f.

paragraphs.ja: 通常の居飛車相手では▲6九玉の一手で速攻を目指す構想。▲3五歩から銀を3五へ進め、銀取りにも▲2四歩を絡めて銀交換を狙う。玉が薄いため、相手の飛車打ちや角筋を具体的に読まずに攻めを急がない。
paragraphs.en: Against some Static Rook formations, K-6i is the economical king move before a fast attack. A third-file pawn break advances the silver, and second-file pressure can sustain the attack even when that silver is threatened. The king remains lightly defended, so calculate enemy rook drops and bishop lines before committing to a material sacrifice or assuming the silver exchange is favorable.

answer.ja: 7九へ引き、5筋の歩を動かして斜めの利きを通す。
answer.en: Withdraw to 7i and open its new diagonal with the fifth-file pawn.

title.ja: 新嬉野流の駒組み

paragraphs.ja: 新嬉野流も▲6八銀で始めるが、角を引く前に▲5六歩、▲5七銀を急ぐ。5六の歩を銀で守り、相手の出方によって矢倉急戦や対振り急戦へ転換できる。角を引く時機を固定しない柔軟さが特徴。
paragraphs.en: New Ureshino retains S-6h but prioritizes P-5f and S-5g before withdrawing the bishop. The silver protects the central pawn promptly and preserves transitions into Yagura quick attacks or anti-Ranging Rook formations. Delaying the bishop move is a practical choice about flexibility and central protection, not simply a cosmetic difference in the final arrangement.

paragraphs.ja: 飛車先交換には▲8七歩と打ち、敵飛車の横取りで5六を狙う筋を減らす。ただし8七の歩が棒銀の争点となり、旧型より攻めが一手早く始まることがある。中央の安全と8筋の防御手数を比較して採用する。
paragraphs.en: After the enemy exchanges its rook pawn, P*8g drives the rook away and limits lateral pressure on 5f. That same pawn becomes a contact point for Climbing Silver, sometimes allowing the enemy attack to begin a move sooner than against P*8h. Weigh the improved central security against this eighth-file liability rather than calling the newer setup universally superior.

question.ja: 新嬉野流が早い5七銀で防ぐ狙いは？
question.en: What does early S-5g help prevent?

answer.ja: 守られていない5六の歩を敵飛車に横取りされる変化。
answer.en: Lateral rook captures of an unsupported pawn on 5f.

title.ja: 嬉野流vs棒銀

paragraphs.ja: 嬉野流は8筋が薄いため、棒銀を見たら左銀を5七から6六へ回す。敵銀の前進に合わせて自銀も進める。飛車先交換前の型と土下座の歩を打った型では受けの場所が違い、手順を区別する。
paragraphs.en: Ureshino’s thin eighth-file defense demands prompt attention when Climbing Silver appears. Route the left silver through 5g toward 6f and coordinate its advance with the enemy silver. Distinguish positions before the rook-pawn exchange from those with the low defensive pawn already dropped; the same-looking attacking silver can require a different defensive destination and timing.

paragraphs.ja: △8五銀には▲6五銀、△8六銀には▲7六銀と引く受けがある。端歩で敵銀の逃げ道を消し、歩で捕獲する筋も読む。新型の8七歩に攻められた場合は低く歩を打ち直して耐えるため、銀だけでなく歩の持ち駒も確認する。
paragraphs.en: A thematic response to S-8e is S-6e, followed by a retreat toward 7f when the enemy enters 8f. Edge-pawn movement can close that silver’s escape route before a pawn traps it. New Ureshino may need a renewed low pawn drop after its pawn on 8g is attacked, so count the available pawns in hand as well as silver coverage.

question.ja: 棒銀への受けに使う嬉野流の銀は？
question.en: Which Ureshino silver is routed to meet Climbing Silver?

answer.ja: 左銀を5七、6六、6五などへ回して受ける。
answer.en: The left silver, routed through 5g and 6f toward the necessary defensive square.

title.ja: 嬉野流vs四間飛車

paragraphs.ja: 四間飛車相手には引き角と斜め棒銀の鳥刺しを狙う。敵美濃が堅いため玉は7八まで移してから戦う。△4五歩で銀の進出を止められたら▲3七桂を跳ね、敵銀が動いたときの▲4五桂を用意する。
paragraphs.en: Against Fourth-file Rook, coordinate the withdrawn bishop and oblique silver as Bird Stab. Move the king toward 7h rather than attacking from its original square against a solid Mino castle. If P-4e blocks the silver’s advance, N-3g prepares a capture on 4e when the opposing silver leaves its current defensive position.

paragraphs.ja: △3二銀待機型には先に▲3五歩を突き捨てて銀を上げる。△4三銀型には銀を先に4六へ出す。嬉野流の角道は閉じているので、敵の△4五歩による角交換の捌きが同じようには働かない。銀の位置による順序の違いを覚える。
paragraphs.en: Against a silver waiting on 3b, sacrifice the third-file pawn before advancing your silver; against S-4c, develop the silver to 4f first. Ureshino’s closed original diagonal prevents the usual bishop-exchange counterplay from operating in the same way. Study these move-order differences by the actual silver position rather than applying a single Bird Stab sequence to every defense.

question.ja: △3二銀待機型と△4三銀型で変わることは？

answer.ja: 3筋の歩を捨てる手と4六銀の順序が変わる。
answer.en: The order of the third-file pawn sacrifice and S-4f changes.

title.ja: 8枚落ち定跡

paragraphs.ja: 上手は飛車・角・両銀・両桂・両香を落とし、上手から指す。下手は飛車と角を働かせ、龍や馬を作る。銀を3八、2七、2六から3五へ進め、2筋の歩を突き捨てて銀を前進させる。
paragraphs.en: White removes rook, bishop, both silvers, both knights, and both lances, and White moves first. Black’s task is to activate the major pieces and make a dragon or horse. Develop the attacking silver through 3h, 2g, and 2f toward 3e, then use a second-file pawn sacrifice to advance that silver with the rook behind it.

paragraphs.ja: 銀を3三へ成り込めば飛車先を軽くでき、角も働く。玉で2筋を守られた場合は銀を捨てて歩を打ち、と金で守備駒を動かす構想を読む。大きな駒得でも、龍を作っただけでは勝ちではない。逃げ道を塞いで詰みへつなげる。
paragraphs.en: Promoting the silver toward 3c can clear the rook file while activating the bishop. If the king reinforces the second-file defense, calculate silver sacrifices followed by pawn drops and promoted-pawn pressure. The material handicap does not replace finishing technique: creating a dragon is a milestone, after which you still need to restrict the king’s escapes and build a mating net.

P-5f is a preparatory move that gives the bishop a retreat to 5g without abandoning the diagonal needed to support the edge attack.

An offered P-8d may lure the bishop into a gold fork, so inspect the gold’s reach before collecting it. Use a hanging pawn to create a promoted pawn after the breakthrough, and distinguish the G-8d defense that can obstruct the straightforward rook invasion.

question.en: Why prepare P-5f before the edge attack?

answer.ja: 角が5七へ引いても9筋への利きを保てるようにする。
answer.en: It lets the bishop retreat to 5g while retaining its edge-attack diagonal.

Develop that silver through 3f toward 2e and advance the first-file pawn, combining Climbing Silver pressure with an edge attack.

answer.en: The silver can occupy 2e and pressure both the first and second files.

title.ja: 2枚落ち定跡

paragraphs.ja: 上手は飛車と角だけを落とすため金銀桂香の守りは残る。下手は早く▲4五歩の位を取り、△4四歩で角道を遮られるのを防ぐ。3筋にも位を取り、銀を上げて前進した歩を守る。位は攻めの足場であって放置できる駒ではない。
paragraphs.en: White removes only rook and bishop, retaining a complete minor-piece defense. Black claims fourth-file space early to prevent P-4d from restricting the bishop, then advances the third-file pawn as well. Develop a silver to support these advanced pawns. Space supplies an attacking platform, but unsupported pawns can become targets even when the opponent has no major pieces.

paragraphs.ja: 二歩突き切りは飛車を3筋へ回して集中攻撃する構想。銀多伝は4筋に銀を縦に並べ、囲いを整えてじっくり前進する。攻撃型と厚み重視の違いを理解し、上手の金銀の連携を切ってから突破する。平手と違い相手に角がないため、4筋の歩の意味も変わる。
paragraphs.en: The Two Advanced Pawns plan brings the rook toward the third file for concentrated pressure. Gintaden arranges two silvers vertically on the fourth file and builds a stronger, slower formation. Choose between direct attack and supported development, then disrupt the defending gold-and-silver coordination. Unlike an even game, White has no bishop whose activity is also reduced by closing a diagonal.

question.ja: 二歩突き切りと銀多伝の構想の違いは？
question.en: How do Two Advanced Pawns and Gintaden differ?

answer.ja: 前者は3筋の集中攻撃、後者は銀の厚みと囲いを整える構想。
answer.en: The first concentrates pressure on the third file; the second emphasizes silver support and a secure formation.
